newsitem.title: USA: FOB GULF GRAIN-SOY OFFERS MOSTLY FLAT, CORN FIRMS.
newsitem.headline: FOB GULF GRAIN-SOY OFFERS MOSTLY FLAT, CORN FIRMS.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers were mostly lower on Thursday while corn values firmed.
Dealers cited subdued activity ahead of the U.S. Department of Agriculture August 12 report. "People want to see what is going to happen," one dealer said.
Dealers also noted limited movement in both corn and soybeans.
On the export front, USDA authorized Pakistan to use $10 million in PL-480 funds to buy U.S. soybean meal. The authorization would pay for about 30,000 tonnes of soymeal.
